meta.title: About · Cosmic Studio, web studio in Geneva & Annecy
meta.description: Cosmic Studio is a web and mobile studio between Geneva and Annecy, run by Matthieu Compérat, who follows your project from the first chat to after launch.

about.title: A small studio, so your customers can find you.
about.lead: Cosmic Studio is Matthieu Compérat, a developer based in Chêne-Bougeries. He builds websites and apps, between Geneva and Annecy.

path.title: Fifteen years in the trade, first for large companies.
paragraphs: Matthieu comes from Duingt, on the shores of Lake Annecy, and has been building websites and apps for about fifteen years. He started out working for large companies, where he learnt to build reliable tools that anyone can use.

With Cosmic Studio, he brings the same standard to the site of a workshop, a practice or an association. He tests every site on a phone, runs automatic checks on every change and reviews everything he delivers. You deal with the person who builds your site, from the first call to the follow-up.

why.title: A small site is built with the same care as a large one.
why.lead: Large agencies mostly work for large companies, and online site builders leave you to figure the tool out on your own. Cosmic Studio is for those in between.

found.title: Get found close to home
found.description: Your customers look for you on their phones, a few kilometres away. A fast, well-built site ranks better on Google.

price.title: A price on display
price.description: The subscription starts at {price} a month, and you can see what each option costs before you write to us. There is no large sum to pay upfront.

answer.title: Someone who answers
answer.description: The person who built your site is the one who answers, usually the same day.

ai.title: AI to save time, always reviewed
ai.description: We use artificial intelligence to work faster, and a person reviews everything it produces. The details are in our legal notice.

cta.title: Write to Matthieu.
cta.description: A few lines about your business are enough to get started.
